worldcombat.skill.healpulse.summary: Sends a healing wave out along the aim line toward a chosen ally; it restores about half of their maximum health on arrival. Flight time depends on distance and wave speed, so farther allies are reached later, and an ally dropped during the wait is missed.
worldcombat.skill.healpulse.use.0: Top an ally up from a distance
worldcombat.skill.healpulse.use.1: Send health before an ally goes down
worldcombat.skill.healpulse.use.2: A travelling rescue across open ground
When the wave reaches the ally it restores %1$s of their maximum health; a higher Special Attack thickens it and a stronger bond makes it warmer.
Castable within %1$s blocks; the wave flies at about %2$s blocks/tick.
worldcombat.skill.healpulse.stance.overc: Overcharge: x1.12 healing, but the wave leaves more slowly (x0.78) and the cooldown is slightly longer - the ally waits longer, for a thick top-up when it is safe.
worldcombat.skill.healpulse.stance.light: Light pulse: the wave travels faster with a shorter cooldown and slightly less healing - for first aid before the ally goes down.
worldcombat.skill.healpulse.timing: Cast on an ally; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.healpulse.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.healpulse.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.healpulse.preference.o: On: x1.12 healing but the wave travels at x0.78 speed (the ally waits longer and is easier to drop first) with a slightly longer cooldown. Off: a faster wave and a shorter cooldown with slightly less healing.
worldcombat.skill.healpulse.preference.a: The companion sends a wave to an ally below this health ratio; lower keeps attacking, higher rescues at the first wound.
The companion only sends a wave to an ally within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher reaches across a gap.
